title: dryopteris simplex
intro: Dryopteris simplex, commonly known as Leathery Wood Fern, is a type of perennial fern native to Eastern North America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, easing respiratory issues, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris simplex include its ability to act as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic, making it a valuable remedy for respiratory and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
